use std::io::{Read,Seek,SeekFrom,Write};
fn main(){
 let dir=tempfile::tempdir().unwrap();let root=dir.path().to_path_buf();
 let mut file=tempfile::NamedTempFile::new_in(&root).unwrap();
 file.write_all(b"temporary data").unwrap();file.seek(SeekFrom::Start(0)).unwrap();
 let mut text=String::new();file.read_to_string(&mut text).unwrap();assert_eq!(text,"temporary data");
 let destination=root.join("kept.txt");let mut kept=file.persist(&destination).unwrap();
 kept.seek(SeekFrom::Start(0)).unwrap();let mut second=String::new();kept.read_to_string(&mut second).unwrap();assert_eq!(text,second);
 drop(kept);assert!(destination.exists());drop(dir);assert!(!root.exists());
 println!("{}",text);
}
